_comment: z-layer scale ratchet (CD-05). Every fixed/portaled overlay must ride the --z-* scale in design/tokens.css via z-[var(--z-*)], NOT a bespoke numeric z-[N]. These are the files that still carry a numeric z-[N] at the ratchet's introduction; zLayerScale.test.ts asserts the live count may only be <= maxArbitraryZLayers AND that no OTHER file carries one — a numeric z-[N] in a clean file turns CI red. Following primitiveAdoption.baseline.json: the count may only SHRINK; ratchet it DOWN in the same commit that clears a file. SessionSkillsReview.tsx is cleared by the sibling PR that routes it through the Modal primitive (which rides --z-modal); CodeCockpitPage.tsx's local bottom-right handoff panel is a follow-up.
